caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden table with a single shallow drawer in the center of the front side, which has a small, round brass knob or keyhole at its center. The table is depicted in a light to medium brown color with different shades indicating the wood grain, and the top surface has a slightly darker tone compared to the sides and legs. The table stands on four straight, turned legs that are slightly tapered and end in small rounded feet. The table is centered within the drawing and set against a plain, light background with faint rectangular boundary lines marking the margins around the object. There is a scale annotation in the lower left corner of the inner rectangle.
title: Desk
